activities.result: Keep a reusable, evidence-backed case for support and grant-ready facts current.
Find and prioritize grants the organization is eligible for and likely to win.
Write a funder-aligned application and learn from the decision.
Meet award reporting and compliance obligations and build the funder relationship.
Plan and write a fundraising appeal or giving campaign.
Retain donors and deepen their support through thanks, reporting back and cultivation.
Define the outcomes that matter and how to measure them.
Report impact honestly to supporters and funders.
Choose a financing route and prepare the lender or investor request through funding.
